sections.headline: Come to heal. Leave transformed.
sections.content:
_Guided sessions with the practitioners of our community — bodywork, breathwork, ceremony, movement and more._

Every healer below lives and works on this land. Book a single session, or choose one of our curated multi-week journeys further down the page.

offers.title: Sound & Touch Healing
offers.description:
With your consent i will work intuitively with healing touch, massages and instruments on and around your bodies. In the Session I use tuning forks, singing bowls, koshis and zimbels to create a sound bath for your whole system.
I invite you to dive in a space of tenderness where you are welcome with everything what is alive in you.

offers.title: Nutrition Coaching
offers.description: All the keys and techniques you need for a juicy life, full of energy, great sleep, improved focus, end chronic pains and allergies. A new you is birthing with each bite.

offers.title: Intimacy & Relationship Coaching
offers.description: Your sexual energy is your life force! Gift yourself a vital upgrade of your love and sex life!
